title: Do not create the Gateway API routers a previous one shadows
body:
### What does this PR do?

Makes the Kubernetes Gateway API provider create only the router serving a given rule on a given entry point.

When several routers share a rule, only the first one a muxer evaluates can serve a request.
The provider now keeps the router of the route the specification gives precedence to, drops the others, and logs a warning.

### Motivation

Two routes attached to the same listener can produce routers with the very same rule,
for example a route without hostname and a route carrying the hostname of the listener.
Which one served the requests was not deterministic, and could change at every configuration reload.

Related to #12795

### More

- [x] Added/updated tests
- [x] Added/updated documentation

### Additional Notes
